cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both the Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View Menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Modern item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases miss coverage for requirements R-176 and R-177 regarding the visual display of the Classic and Modern themes. Additionally, requirements R-180 and R-181 state that 'Classic' and 'Modern' items should be under the View menu, but requirements R-175 state themes are under theme preferences, introducing a potential contradiction or distinct menu placement that needs dedicated validation cases.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 lack test cases for verifying the visual display of Classic and Modern themes against the given images.

opinions.feedback: No blockers found. The test cases appropriately cover the provided requirements.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario verifies both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences. Abnormal or unsupported states like corrupted configurations are excluded per feedback. For R-176: Blocked due to missing reference image specified in the requirement. For R-177: Blocked due to missing reference image specified in the requirement. For R-178: Normal scenario verifies 'Theme Preferences' item is available under the View menu. For R-179: Normal scenario verifies 'Get New Themes' item is available under the View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario verifies 'Classic' item is available under the View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario verifies 'Modern' item is available under the View menu.
